scenes.h1: Is your child ready to learn the Quran?
scenes.ur: کیا آپ کا بچہ قرآن سیکھنے کے لیے تیار ہے؟
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Is your child ready to learn the Quran?
At Nurul Huda Academy, it starts with a free trial class.
Just tell us your child's age, their level, and the times that suit you.

scenes.ur: جانچے پرکھے اساتذہ، خواتین اساتذہ بھی دستیاب
scenes.sub: We match you with a tested teacher. Female teachers on request.
Every class is one to one, live, 30 minutes, with the Quran page on screen.
After every class, a short report: where your child reached, and what to practise next.
Your first class is free. Book today at nurulhudaacademy.org
